title: 1권 9유닛 장면 · 1
prompt: Flat vector illustration in the style of a modern children's English textbook: simple geometric shapes, bold flat solid colors, at most one flat darker shadow tone per object, clean smooth edges with no outlines or only very thin dark outlines, rounded friendly forms, no texture, no gradients, no watercolor, no paper grain, no photo-realism, no 3D render. Bright cheerful palette (red, orange, yellow, green, blue, sky blue). Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks anywhere in the image. Full illustrated scene: the background is made of a few large flat color shapes (ground, bushes, sky) with a calm plain sky area near the top, characters large and clearly visible. No text, no letters. Do NOT draw any speech bubbles, thought bubbles or empty white balloons of any kind. The characters must look exactly like the ones in the attached character sheet (left to right: Pip, Bun, Hedgie, Grumble). Scene: A cozy little village corner inside the garden: a small house wall with a window with blue curtains and a flower pot on the sill, a stone water fountain, and a yellow taxi parked on the lane. In the middle of the lane a small volcano mound rumbles with little puffs of smoke, and a glowing golden seed sits on its rim. Hedgie points at the volcano nervously; Bun leans in curiously; Pip is trying to say a sound but its whole body buzzes like a bee, feathers vibrating with little motion lines. Hidden in the picture: the volcano, a blue knitted vest hanging on a washing line, the taxi. Grumble sits on a stack of boxes nearby with a pinecone stuck in each ear, arms crossed, eyes shut; his lantern beside him shines very bright, like a small star. Characters: Pip is a small round yellow baby songbird standing on tiny orange feet, big sparkling black eyes with rosy cheeks, a cowlick of three little feathers on top of the head, a cream-colored belly patch shaped like a musical note, short stubby wings held like little arms, a small orange beak closed shyly, wearing a single small green leaf tied around its neck like a scarf. Bun is a small white rabbit standing on two legs, one long ear flopped down, green rain boots, brave smile. Hedgie is a small hedgehog standing on two legs, soft spikes with one tiny flower stuck in them, curious cautious eyes. Grumble is a grumpy old raccoon standing on two legs, dark eye mask, a striped nightcap, holding a tiny candle lantern in one paw, frowning sleepily, slippers.
